title: Control Flow: Conditionals and Loops
description: Learn how to control the flow of execution using if-else statements and loops to write logic-driven Python programs.

lessons.title: What is Control Flow?
lessons.content: Control flow refers to the order in which individual statements, instructions, or function calls are executed in a Python program. It allows decisions and repetitions.

lessons.title: if Statement
lessons.content:
```python
x = 10
if x > 5:
    print("x is greater than 5")
```

lessons.title: if-else Statement
lessons.content:
```python
age = 18
if age >= 18:
    print("You can vote")
else:
    print("You cannot vote")
```

lessons.title: if-elif-else Statement
Comparison and Logical Operators
lessons.content:
- **Comparison**: `==`, `!=`, `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`
- **Logical**: `and`, `or`, `not`
Example:
```python
if age > 18 and age < 60:
    print("Working age")
```

lessons.title: while Loop
lessons.content:
```python
count = 0
while count < 5:
    print("Count:", count)
    count += 1
```

lessons.title: break and continue
Nested Loops and Conditions
Practice: Guess the Number Game
lessons.content:
```python
secret = 7
guess = int(input("Guess a number between 1 and 10: "))
while guess != secret:
    print("Wrong! Try again.")
    guess = int(input("Guess: "))
print("Correct!")
```
